title: Existence of an fpqc amalgamation
statement: Let k be a field, f:C to Spec k a smooth proper geometrically integral curve, d an integer, and S the fibrewise-degree-d subfunctor [lem-pd-degree-locally-constant]. For an fpqc sieve R on T and a compatible family x of sections of its fppf sheafification, an amalgamation exists.

proof.text: Let Q be the fppf sheafification of the degree-d subfunctor and tau:Q to Pic_{C/k} the sheafified inclusion. Sheafification preserves monomorphisms, so tau is objectwise injective. Every Q-section has image of degree d: choose an fppf-local subfunctor representative over each point and use degree base change [lem-pd-degree-locally-constant].

Map the compatible family along tau and use the fpqc sheaf condition [lem-pd-picard-sheaf-fpqc] to obtain an amalgamation t in the full Picard sheaf. Every point of the test scheme lifts to an arrow of the fpqc sieve. Degree base change then proves t has degree d at every point.

The fppf-local Picard-presheaf representatives of t all have degree d by [lem-pd-degree-locally-constant], hence belong to the given subfunctor. Thus the image sieve of tau at t is fppf covering. Choose its local preimages; injectivity of tau makes them compatible. Glue in Q using its fppf sheaf condition. Separatedness of the full Picard sheaf shows the glued image is t, and injectivity of tau shows this section amalgamates the original family.

theorem exists_amalgamation_fpqc_sheafify_picardDegree
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsProper f] [GeometricallyIntegral f]
    (d : ℤ) (S : Subfunctor (picardPresheaf f))
    (hS : ∀ (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (L : (picardPresheaf f).obj (op T)),
      L ∈ S.obj (op T) ↔ ∀ t, picardPresheafDegree f L t = d)
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (R : Sieve T)
    (hR : R ∈ (Scheme.fpqcTopology.over (Spec (.of k))) T)
    (x : Presieve.FamilyOfElements
      ((presheafToSheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over (Spec (.of k))) (Type (u + 1))).obj
        S.toFunctor).obj R.arrows)
    (hx : x.Compatible) :
    ∃ t, x.IsAmalgamation t
